description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Twitch''' hurls a cask of corrosive mixture at the target location that breaks upon landing, applying ''[[File:Twitch Deadly Venom.png|20xpx|border|link=Twitch#Deadly Venom|An icon for Twitch's ability Deadly Venom]] [[Twitch#Deadly Venom|Deadly Venom]]'' to enemies in the area and granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of it.
description.text: Active: Twitch hurls a cask of corrosive mixture at the target location that breaks upon landing, applying Deadly Venom to enemies in the area and granting sight of it.

description2.raw: The area then becomes contaminated for 3 seconds, applying a ''[[File:Twitch Deadly Venom.png|20xpx|border|link=Twitch#Deadly Venom|An icon for Twitch's ability Deadly Venom]] [[Twitch#Deadly Venom|Deadly Venom]]'' stack each second to enemies within and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them.
description2.text: The area then becomes contaminated for 3 seconds, applying a Deadly Venom stack each second to enemies within and slowing them.

leveling2.raw:
'''Slow:'''
30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50% (+ 6% per 100 AP)

notes.raw: * ''Venom Cask'' can apply a maximum of 4 [[File:Twitch Deadly Venom.png|20xpx|border|link=Twitch#Deadly Venom|An icon for Twitch's ability Deadly Venom]] [[Twitch#Deadly Venom|Deadly Venom]] stacks per enemy per cast. * ''Venom Cask's'' missile will fail to fire if '''Twitch''' is [[File:Suppression icon.png|20px|link=Types of Crowd Control#Suppression|An icon representing the keyword Suppression]] [[:Types of Crowd Control#Suppression|suppressed]] during the cast time.(unexpected)
notes.text:
Venom Cask can apply a maximum of 4 Deadly Venom stacks per enemy per cast.
Venom Cask's missile will fail to fire if Twitch is suppressed during the cast time.(unexpected)
